provenance: 60 synthetic author-labelled scenarios written on 17 November 2026 before changing the 1.4.1 detector. Frozen for before/after comparison by the same implementer; development evaluation, not an independent holdout or real-world accuracy sample.
interpretation: Synthetic, author-labelled development challenge set; not a held-out or independently validated real-world accuracy estimate. A warning means scam OR caution. Ambiguous examples are excluded from precision/recall and false-alarm rates. Context answers are not used.

outcomes.rationale: Fictional impostor uses a changed-number story and an indirect money request.
